05 — Jugaad Realty

Property is not always just about property.

Some real-estate situations are straightforward. Others involve complicated ownership histories, development possibilities, stakeholder interests, stalled projects or commercial and institutional considerations. Jugaad Realty focuses on understanding such situations and helping identify practical routes forward.

Areas of engagement

  • Complex property opportunities
  • Landowner–developer discussions
  • Stalled or disputed property situations
  • Development concepts and opportunity evaluation
  • Commercial and transaction coordination
  • Stakeholder discussions
  • Connecting relevant technical, legal and development professionals
